title: In vitro and In silico Studies on Leonotis nepetifolia (L.) R. Br. Root Extract against Cancer Cells.
authors: Merecz-Sadowska, Anna; Sitarek, Przemyslaw; Sliwinski, Tomasz; Zajdel, Karolina; Malinowska, Katarzyna; Zielinska-Blizniewska, Hanna; Kucharska, Ewa; Zajdel, Radoslaw
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物根提取物对黑色素瘤细胞的细胞毒与凋亡作用，仅含少量小分子与Mdm-2蛋白的对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，亦无AI或MD方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Leonotis nepetifolia (L.) R. Br. (Lamiaceae) is a shrub traditionally used to alleviate inflammatory conditions. OBJECTIVES: The present study aimed at investigating the biological activity of methanolic nontransformed and transformed Rhizobium rhizogenes root extracts from L. nepetifolia against human melanoma cells. METHODS: Cytotoxicity and genotoxicity properties, the impact on topoisomerase I activity, and proapoptotic activity were evaluated by the MTT test, comet assay, topoisomerase I assay, and fluorescence-activated cell sorting analysis. Moreover, the expressions of p53 were examined by qPCR and Western blot analysis. Docking studies were conducted to assess the potential interactions of the identified phytochemicals with the p53 binding protein Mdm-2, and computational analyses exhibited their antioxidant potential. RESULTS: Both extracts showed cytotoxic potential against human melanoma cells, but generally the activity was more potent for transformed roots than untransformed (IC(50) 760 mug/mL and 980 mug/mL, respectively). A similar effect was revealed during the evaluation of genotoxic and proapoptotic properties. Moreover, the expression of p53 was also found to be increased after extract treatment. The most dominant identified compounds in both extracts were as follows: (+)- catechin, p-coumaric acid, m-coumaric acid, and (+)-rosmarinic acid. Docking studies and computational analysis showed that (+)-rosmarinic acid possesses the highest binding affinity to the p53 binding protein, Mdm-2, and exhibits the best antioxidant property from the most commonly identified phytochemicals. CONCLUSION: Our findings revealed the potential of L. nepetifolia transformed root extract as a source of bioactive compounds with cytotoxic, genotoxic, and proapoptotic activity against human melanoma cells as well as antioxidant properties.
abstract_zh: 背景：Leonotis nepetifolia (L.) R. Br.（唇形科）是一种传统上用于缓解炎症状况的灌木。目的：本研究旨在探讨来自L. nepetifolia的甲醇非转化和转化的根瘤菌 (Rhizobium rhizogenes) 根提取物对人黑色素瘤细胞的生物活性。方法：通过MTT试验、彗星试验、拓扑异构酶I试验和荧光激活细胞分选分析评估了细胞毒性和遗传毒性特性、对拓扑异构酶I活性的影响以及促凋亡活性。此外，通过qPCR和Western blot分析检测了p53的表达。进行了对接研究以评估已鉴定植物化学物质与p53结合蛋白Mdm-2的潜在相互作用，计算分析展示了其抗氧化潜力。结果：两种提取物均显示出对人黑色素瘤细胞的细胞毒性潜力，但总体上转化根的活性强于非转化根（IC(50)分别为760 μg/mL和980 μg/mL）。在遗传毒性和促凋亡特性的评估中也显示出类似效果。此外，提取物处理后p53的表达也发现增加。两种提取物中最主要的已鉴定化合物如下：(+)-儿茶素、对香豆酸、间香豆酸和(+)-迷迭香酸。对接研究和计算分析表明，(+)-迷迭香酸对p53结合蛋白Mdm-2具有最高的结合亲和力，并在最常鉴定的植物化学物质中表现出最佳的抗氧化特性。结论：我们的发现揭示了L. nepetifolia转化根提取物作为具有细胞毒性、遗传毒性和促凋亡活性以及抗氧化特性的人黑色素瘤细胞生物活性化合物来源的潜力。
